title: The Name On The Key Tag 🤖 FINALE

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The tag. One name. [beat] Not a thief's name. [beat] Not a teacher's name. [beat] 'JOY.'

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: …Okay. OKAY! It was me! [beat] But you don't know WHY. [beat] Nobody asked WHY!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Bro… [beat] you're the loyal one. [beat] That's your whole THING.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: EXACTLY! [beat] Three weeks ago I heard them in the office. [beat] Fail half the class… [beat] charge re-exam fees. TWICE.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: The budget meeting. [beat] The school needed money. [beat] The exam was the weapon.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I didn't steal answers. [beat] I stole the PAPER. [beat] No paper… no mass fail… [beat] no fees.

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: And I thought I lost my job over a folder… [beat] when the folder was protecting MY students.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: That plan was NOT mine. [beat] The BOARD proposed it. [beat] And the board… [beat] answers to me. Tonight.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: PLOT TWIST! The thief is the HERO! [beat] The principal is FURIOUS! [beat] I have never been so alive!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: So the REAL conspiracy… [beat] was upstairs the whole time. [beat] I'm never wrong. [beat] Just early.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: New exam. Fair exam. Written where everyone can SEE it. [beat] And Joy…

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I know. Detention. [beat] For life. [beat] …Worth it.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for the next story — [beat] because if a samosa can start a war… [beat] imagine what a report card does.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The paper was never the mystery. [beat] The question was always… [beat] who's actually loyal to WHO.
